notes: Large-source unit checked: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר → *whithersoever* is genuinely indivisible — the one English word carries the locative, the universal quantification and the relative alike, so rule 30's condition is met and no morpheme is left over (rule 22's prohibition). Headed on אֲשֶׁר; heading on כֹּל was the competing reading (rule 8).
*and served him not*: the negative is postposed and its unit discontinuous under rule 25.
